templates.title: Steamos
templates.name: steamos
templates.description: SteamOS is an Arch based Linux distribution made by Valve Software. This container is a vanilla Arch install with Steam repositories added for software support. This container will only work with modern AMD/Intel GPUs on a real Linux Host
